senses.sense_definition: Small pieces of colored paper or other material thrown during celebrations, especially at weddings or parties.

examples.text: The guests threw colorful <w>confetti</w> as the newlyweds walked out of the church.
After the countdown ended, a shower of paper <w>confetti</w> fell from the ceiling.

senses.sense_definition: Sugar-coated almonds traditionally given as treats or favors at Italian weddings and celebrations.

examples.text: The host placed small pouches of traditional Italian <w>confetti</w> beside each plate.
Trays filled with colored almond <w>confetti</w> were prepared for the wedding reception.

senses.sense_definition: To scatter confetti over an area or person.

examples.text: The parade crowd cheered loudly and <w>confettied</w> the street below.
Volunteers quickly <w>confettied</w> the stage right as the winning team arrived.
